dedupe_keys.name: natural hazards research summit 2024 large scale testing of ductile mass timber concrete connections

description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024: Large-Scale Testing of Ductile Mass Timber- Concrete Connections is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Gloria Faraone, San Diego State University (sdsu.edu). The scope of this project is to develop an improved ductile-anchor connection with replaceable threaded rods to be placed at the superstructure-concrete footing interface in mass timber buildings to improve their seismic performance in seismically active regions. Coverage: College Park, MD. DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-q49y-sg35. Keywords: CLT; concrete footing; connections; anchor; ductility;. Published 2024-06-14. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
